objective: Qualify one paid WordPress theme/plugin update pass using existing LazyingArt publishing work, before considering any recurring maintenance.

source_need.title: WordPress site updates
source_need.budget: Not stated; the requester explicitly offers payment for theme/plugin updates and regular maintenance.
source_need.scope: A personal teaching-service site needs theme and plugin updates after repeated security-update notices.
source_need.application_invitation: The listing explicitly supplies an Apply via Email route.
source_need.public_site_observation: The advertised contact domain redirects to an active music-teaching website. The requester has not confirmed which installation or plugin inventory is in scope.

fit.supported_now: An existing first-party WordPress publication maintained by LazyingArt; its public homepage returned HTTP 200 during preparation.
fit.decision: The earlier recurring-maintenance exclusion remains for an open-ended obligation. This inquiry instead asks whether one separately quoted update pass is useful, without creating a new service page or accepting ongoing support.
not_claimed: A customer WordPress maintenance case study
Diagnosis of this site's plugins or security state
A guaranteed safe upgrade before compatibility and backup checks
A fixed price, delivery date or ongoing support availability before scope review

application.method: One visibly reviewed response to the advertised email application invitation.
application.delivery_evidence: One Send action closed the reviewed composer. The complete normalized body, subject and recipient matched in Sent; the sender address was separately opened and visually checked.
application.development_method_disclosed: AI-assisted tools, with changes tested before release
application.follow_up_policy: Watch for a relevant reply; do not send another message without one. Metadata signals are not proof of buyer qualification.
application.inbound_coverage: One sender-and-subject rule added to the existing hourly iCloud checker; changed subjects or participant names can require separate scoped review.

scope_gate: Confirm the request remains open, remote eligibility and the exact site
Obtain theme/plugin names and versions plus hosting and licensing details before quoting; no credentials requested in the inquiry
Agree a fixed first-pass scope, price, acceptance checks, revision limit and delivery terms before access or work
Require an authorized staging copy, complete recoverable backup and explicit release approval; test tuition pages and the enquiry form with approved test data
Separate paid-license renewals, malware recovery, abandoned-plugin replacement, migrations and custom repairs from ordinary updates
No recurring support, emergency availability or automatic renewal without a separate accepted agreement
